signing_profile.scope: Compiled Go signing test harness: repeated small synthetic local signing, bounded envelope/bundle parsing, historical offline keyless verification and cancelled signing; excludes artifact hashing, git and output writes.

sampled_in_use_profile.sampling: Go default allocation sampling; separate from complete runtime.MemStats lifecycle values

large_artifact_gate.scope: Unchanged M2 manifest/verify and M3 unsigned record/inspect workload, independently checked 1 GiB SHA-256, same 64 MiB peak-working-set gate; production Make/Docker compiler flags are now used.

fuzz_smoke.limitation: Short parser smoke with 1 MiB per generated fuzz input; explicit unit tests separately cover full byte/token/depth/proof boundaries.

public_good_trust_setup.live_keyless_signing: not run locally; requires authorized GitHub Actions publication

limits: These are bounded synthetic/native measurements, not an artifact-safety, original-build-history, unlimited-lifetime leak-freedom or platform-wide performance claim. Final Windows/Ubuntu/macOS and live signing CI are pending publication.
